notes: Standalone canvas playground with a custom fixed-step 2D rigid-body engine, circle/polygon SAT collision detection, spatial-hash broadphase, iterative friction/restitution impulses with penetration bias, distance/revolute/spring joints, sleeping, adaptive motion substeps, editing tools, six built-in scenes, debug overlays, undo, browser-local save, JSON export and import. JavaScript syntax, app boot, metadata, and all six scenario smoke tests passed; each scenario advanced 30 fixed steps with finite body state. A 10-second code-level tower simulation completed with residual body speeds below 0.3 px/s in the test harness. A full browser runtime session could not be established in this environment, so visual interaction and 500+ body frame-rate targets remain unverified. The solver uses one representative contact point per pair; adaptive substeps reduce tunnelling risk but are not a formal continuous-collision-detection implementation.
